params.description:

items.docs:
Allows querying for the public metrics for viewership about a video.
This can be called from the frontend with a CORS key, or even
unauthenticated.

params.name: from
params.description: Start millis timestamp for the query range (inclusive)

params.name: to
params.description: End millis timestamp for the query range (exclusive)

params.name: timeStep
params.description: The time step to aggregate viewership metrics by

params.name: creatorId
params.description: The creator ID to filter the query results

params.name: breakdownBy[]
params.description:
The list of fields to break down the query results. Currently the
only supported breakdown is by `creatorId`.
